decisions.reason: Although the training programme is relatively easy to scale back, it extends the firm’s established service business and strategic customer-support positioning, so management would be inclined to continue it unless weak demand clearly persisted.

The fourth rotary axis accessory fits the installed base and the firm’s core machining offer, and even with only modest public visibility management would tend to retain such a complementary product rather than admit a quick reversal.

Hybrid additive post-processing is comparatively distant from the firm’s established offer and was only lightly committed on the website, so despite the firm’s innovative orientation management has less justification to keep backing it if results remain unclear.

A high-speed CNC milling machine line with several models represents heavy sunk development costs, strong public commitment, and a close fit with the firm’s announced direction, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The automatic tool change system builds directly on the firm’s core equipment business and was given its own page, so management would likely keep supporting it and treat any disappointment as a temporary commercialization issue rather than abandon it.
